overall_goal: Roll out the puff pastry on a floured surface and cut it into strips.

goals.description: Retrieve the flour and rolling pin.
goals.rationale: The person fetches the container of flour and the rolling pin from their respective storage locations to prepare for rolling out the pastry.

goals.description: Flour the work surface and place the puff pastry.
goals.rationale: The person opens the flour, dusts the countertop to prevent sticking, and transfers the puff pastry onto the floured surface.

goals.description: Flour the rolling pin and begin rolling out the pastry.
goals.rationale: The person coats the rolling pin with flour and starts flattening the pastry, crimping the edges and flipping it to ensure an even roll.

goals.description: Remove air pockets and continue rolling the pastry.
goals.rationale: The person pushes down on the pastry to eliminate air bubbles, rotates it, and continues to roll it flat.

goals.description: Fold edges, flip, and finish rolling the pastry.
goals.rationale: The person folds in the edges to shape the pastry, flips it over, and gives it a final roll to reach the desired thickness.

goals.description: Clean and flour the knife for cutting.
goals.rationale: The person wipes the serrated knife with a towel and rubs flour onto the blade so it cuts cleanly through the dough.
The person repeatedly slices the flattened pastry into even strips, occasionally re-flouring the knife to prevent sticking.

goals.description: Cut the pastry strips in half.
goals.rationale: The person groups the cut strips together and slices down the center to halve their length.
